description_en: Sets column encryption permissions for database accounts in batches
description_zh: 批量设置数据库账号列加密权限
name: UpdateDataMaskingUsers

parameters.help_en:
The cloud product type identifier. Valid values:

5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

If both ProductId and ProductCode are specified, they must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two parameters must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The column encryption access permissions. Valid values:

fullAccess: plaintext access.
restrictedAccess: restricted access.
noneAccess: decryption denied.

noneAccess applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances whose active key pattern is client_key
parameters.help_zh: 列加密访问权限。fullAccess：明文访问；restrictedAccess：受限访问；noneAccess：禁止解密。noneAccess 仅适用于 RDS MySQL 且当前生效密钥模式为 client_key 的实例
parameters.name: auth_role

fields.help_en: The database account identifier. Obtain this value from Items[].Id in the response of ListDataAssetAccounts and pass it as a string
fields.help_zh: 数据库账号标识，从 ListDataAssetAccounts 的 Items[].Id 获取，按字符串传入
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en: The database instance identity. Obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of ListDataMaskingInstances
fields.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
fields.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of database accounts for which to set permissions
parameters.help_zh: 待设置权限的数据库账号列表
parameters.name: user_list

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on the permission expiration time. Valid values:

PRESERVE: Retains the existing expiration time.
CLEAR: Clears the expiration time.
SET: Sets the expiration time to the value specified by ExpireTime.

Default value: PRESERVE. Only fullAccess supports configuring a validity period
parameters.help_zh: 权限到期时间的处理方式。PRESERVE：保留原到期时间；CLEAR：清除到期时间；SET：设置 ExpireTime。默认 PRESERVE。仅 fullAccess 支持设置有效期
parameters.name: expire_time_operation

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the plaintext access permissions. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. This parameter is required only when ExpireTimeOperation is set to SET. The value must be later than the current time and no later than 2145953410000. The server stores the value with second-level precision. Do not specify this parameter when ExpireTimeOperation is set to PRESERVE or CLEAR
parameters.help_zh: 明文访问权限到期时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。仅 ExpireTimeOperation=SET 时填写，必须晚于当前时间且不大于 2145953410000；服务端按秒精度保存。PRESERVE 或 CLEAR 时不传
parameters.name: expire_time

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
